title: Hand Embroidery 101 | Beginners Guide to Embroidery, Stitch Tutorials, and Pattern!
description:
Hand Embroidery 101 | Everything you need to know about embroidery basics, my favorite stitches, how to's, and more! In this video I'll show you close ups of how to do the Back Stitch, Split Stitch, Stem Stitch, Lazy Daisy Stitch, French Knot Stitch, and Satin Stitch!
